answers.solution:
Wrote the full solution to **`~/SOLUTION.md`**. Here's the essence:

## Root cause
`golangci-lint` applies output caps *after* analysis, so the summary and exit code reflect truncated results only. Defaults (verified from v2.14.0 `--help`):

| Flag | Default |
|---|---|
| `--max-issues-per-linter` | 50 |
| `--max-same-issues` | 3 |
| `--uniq-by-line` | true |

The reported tick was dominated by `--max-same-issues=3`: 32 identical-text `errcheck` issues collapsed to 3.

## Reproduced exactly (32 vs 61)
Built `/tmp/repro6161` with 32 identical `errcheck` issues + 29 distinct `ineffassign` issues:

```console
$ golangci-lint run --no-config ./...
32 issues:  errcheck: 3,  ineffassign: 29

$ golangci-lint run --no-config --max-issues-per-linter=0 --max-same-issues=0 ./...
61 issues:  errcheck: 32, ineffassign: 29
```

Also confirmed the per-linter cap independently (60 distinct `govet` issues → 50 default / 60 uncapped) and `--uniq-by-line` (2 same-line issues → 1 default / 2 with `--uniq-by-line=false`).

## Fix
```bash
golangci-lint run --max-issues-per-linter=0 --max-same-issues=0 ./...
```
Persist in `.golangci.yml` (v2):
```yaml
version: "2"
issues:
  max-issues-per-linter: 0
  max-same-issues: 0
```
Robust QA inventory via JSON:
```bash
golangci-lint run --max-issues-per-linter=0 --max-same-issues=0 \
  --output.json.path=/tmp/golangci.json ./... >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
jq '.Issues | length' /tmp/golangci.json   # 61
```

The doc includes the full reproducer, config variants (v1/v2), per-linter grouping, and a verification checklist.
